verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS compliance platform like Thoropass, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The nearest items are MCP 'limits you set' and the AI Helpbot transparency overview, which cover agent permissions and bot behavior, not tracking controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
